signals.title: fix: Windows tar symlink extraction and fastai CI dependency resolution
signals.text: Fixes the three classes of CI failure currently red on `main`: 1. **unit-tests (windows)** — `test_from_fs_preserves_safe_tar_symlink` fails with `OSError: [Errno 22]`. Safe tar extraction creates symlinks with POSIX-style targets; Windows cannot resolve forward-slash link targets. Fix: normalize the linkname separator on Windows (`src/bentoml/_internal/utils/filesystem.py`) + platform-agnostic readlink assertion. 2. **framework-integration-tests (fastai)** — pip backtracks to a versioneer-era fsspec sdist that no longer builds on Python ≥ 3.12. Fix: `fsspec>=2023.1.0` floor in `noxfile.py`. 3. **all python3.9 jobs (since 2026-08-14)** — pdm 2.28.1 (released 2026-08-11, picked up by the unpinned `pipx install pdm`) crashes `pdm sync` against py3.9 target environments. Fix: pin `pdm==2.28.0` in `ci.yml`. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
